steps.text: Principle of superposition: resultant displacement = vector sum of the individual displacements.
Constructive interference when the path difference is nλ; destructive when it is (n + ½)λ.
Coherent sources have a constant phase difference, so stable fringes form.
Double slit: equally spaced bright fringes with spacing x = λD/s.
Stationary waves form when two identical waves travel in opposite directions.
Nodes and antinodes are λ/2 apart; energy is stored, not transferred.
